admin.title: Administration
admin.errForbidden: You don't have permission to change this. Only an admin can.

recovery.title: Someone forgot their password
recovery.username: A username account can't be sent a reset — its address is on a reserved domain that receives no mail. Press ⁨{action}⁩ on their row instead, hand the code over the way you handed over the first one, and they choose a new password when they redeem it.
recovery.usernameKeepsWorking: Their old password keeps working until that new code is redeemed. Issuing one is a spare key, not a lock change — if a password has to stop working right now, remove the account and create it again.
recovery.email: An account that signs in with a real email address never needs you for this. It can have a sign-in code mailed to it from the sign-in screen.
recovery.self: Your own password works the same way, while you are still signed in: ⁨{action}⁩ on your own row, then redeem the code yourself. Once you are signed out there is no self-service left — RUNBOOK §3.1 is the way back.
recovery.noEmailAdmin: No admin here can get back in without another admin. Every admin in this workspace signs in with a username, and a username account has no mailbox anything can be sent to — so if the last one forgets their password, nothing inside the app can restore access. Give at least one admin a real email address. The way back from here is the Supabase dashboard: RUNBOOK §3.1.

tracks.title: Tracks
tracks.subtitle: Add, rename, recolour and reorder the tracks that work is filed under.
tracks.name: Name (English)
tracks.suggestedTagsHint: Offered at capture and broken out in this track’s view and the digest. Onboarding uses these for its two integration paths.
tracks.colorHint: Two hexes, so the identity bar keeps its contrast in both themes.
tracks.deleteBody: “⁨{name}⁩” will be removed permanently. This can't be undone.
tracks.deleteBodyInUse: “⁨{name}⁩” still holds {entries}, {meetings}, {templates} and {nodes}. Choose where to move them first.
tracks.archiveBody: “⁨{name}⁩” disappears from the pickers. Existing items keep it and nothing is deleted.
tracks.discardBody: Your edits to this track haven't been saved. Leaving now discards them.
tracks.reassignNoTargets: There is no other active track to move them to. Add one, or restore an archived track, then delete this one.
tracks.emptyHint: Add your first track to start filing work under it.
tracks.errNameLong: Keep the name to {max} characters or fewer.
tracks.errNameTaken: Another track already uses that name.
tracks.errNameArTaken: Another track already uses that Arabic name.
tracks.errInUse: That track still holds items. Move them to another track first.
tracks.errLastTrack: At least one active track has to remain.
tracks.errReassignArchived: That destination is archived. Items moved there would disappear from every list — pick an active track.
tracks.errReassignSelf: Pick a different track to move the items to.
tracks.slaRule: A number here wins over the priority's workspace default. Leave it empty to inherit.
tracks.slaAfterSave: Save the track first. Deadlines hang off a track, so this one needs an identity before it can carry any.
tracks.errSlaRange: Enter a number between {min} and {max}, or leave it empty to inherit.
tracks.errNotFound: That track no longer exists. Reload the list.
